# Apache Arrow JavaScript browser bundle provenance

The vendored browser distribution is Apache Arrow JavaScript
`apache-arrow@21.2.0`, copied byte-for-byte from the `Arrow.es2015.min.js`
browser distribution in the package release.

The package metadata identifies version `21.2.0`, license `Apache-2.0`, upstream
repository `https://github.com/apache/arrow-js`, and `Arrow.es2015.min.js` as
both its `unpkg` and `jsdelivr` browser distribution. The self-contained UMD
bundle is stored as `arrow-21.2.0.min.js`. The upstream `LICENSE.txt` and
`NOTICE.txt` are preserved as `APACHE-ARROW-JS-LICENSE.txt` and
`APACHE-ARROW-JS-NOTICE.txt`; the JavaScript file also retains its upstream
Apache license header. `ARROW-JS-SHA256SUMS` records hashes for all three files.

The viewer serves this bundle to decode Arrow IPC pages and inspect nested Arrow
cells.
